text.body: atha kaśyapasmṛtiḥ prāyaścittavarṇanam atha kāśyapīyān gṛhasthadharmān vyākhyāsyāmaḥ āhitāgniḥ svadāranirato'cāgnyagnihotrī snātāmṛtukālagāmī devapitṛmanuṣyabhūtabrahmayajñānusevamānaḥ ekadvitricaturṇāṃ brāhmaṇān kurvāṇo vrataniyamahomajāpyaparo mātṛpitṛbhakto dārāpatyapoṣakaḥ śeṣānubhojī upavāsī traivarṇikamedakasūtakānnapariharamāṇo'lāṃgalavṛttiḥ || tatra ca bhūmyapoḍhane vṛkṣacchedane nāsyadharmobhavati || kūpasetutaḍāgavipradevatāyatanabhedane prāyaścittaṃ brāhmaṇebhyo nivedya catasraāhutīrjuhuyāt || idaṃ viṣṇuriti prathamā mānastoka iti dvitīyā svavāsā iti tṛtīyā daṃṣṭrābhyāmiti caturthīratyasrapoḍhayet tasyaiva devatāyai pūrṇāhutiṃ juhuyāt || atha gobalīvardamahiṣadhūryāvikahiṃsāvāptau prāyaścittakāmakāratāmityeke || dogdhṛdamanaparyastapāṣaghaṭṭanaghaṃṭābharaṇabhūṣaṇayojana tailamaṃḍauṣadhabheṣajyatritayamāṇe vyāptānāmakāmāvāptyai prāyaścittaṃbrāhmaṇebhyo nivedya saśirakṣuravapanaṃ kṛtvā prājāpatyaṃ kṛcchramācaret || cīrṇāṃte gāṃ dadyāt || tiladhenuṃ jaladhenuṃ cetikāśyapaḥ || atha mṛgamahiṣagaṃḍukavarāhaśarabhaṛkṣasiṃhavyāghramaṃḍūkaśūkara matsyagrāhaśiśumārādīnāṃ vadheṣvahorātraṃ || cīrṇāṃte gāṃ dadyāt || meṣa sa trirātraṃ cīrṇānte hiraṇyaṃ dadyāt || atha kākavalākahaṃsasārasakāraṇḍavacakravākagṛdhraśyenakhaṃjarīṭaṭiṭṭibholūkaśuka sārikāmayūrakākamadra kalaviṃkakapota kapiṃjalādīnāṃ vadheṣvahorātraṃ cīrṇānte tilāndadyāt || athātaḥ śvajambūkaviḍālaṛṣabharakṣuvāsatoṣṭra śūdra vadhe trirātraṃ ca prāyaścittaṃ brāhmaṇebhyo nivedya prājāpatyaṃ kṛcchraṃ caret || cīrṇānte savrīhīn dadyāt || kṛkalāsasarpanakulaviḍālagojāvadhe trirātraṃ cīrṇānte lohaṃ dadyāt || yeṣāṃ vyāpādane prāyaścittamuktaṃ teṣāmevocchiṣṭabhojane prāṇāyāmaśataṃkṛtvā ghṛtaṃ prāśya śuddhaḥ syāt || jātamṛtakasūtake brāhmaṇo daśarātreṇa kṣatriyaḥ paṃcadaśakena vaiśyoviṃśatirātreṇa śūdro māsena śuddhyati || taccedaṃtaḥpuravāpataṃti tatsamena śudhyāvasvahaḥ || abrāhmaṇo na jāyate nādhīyīta nādhyāpayet na dadyāt na pratigṛhṇīyāt || aśucirdvipade catuṣpade nāditadahaḥ || athānaśanamṛtānāmaśanihatānāṃ vā agnipraviṣṭānāṃ bhṛgupatanasaṃgrāmadeśāṃ taramṛtānāṃ vā garbhaviniḥsṛtānāṃ trirātreṇa śuddhirucyate || atha laśunapalāṃḍugṛñjanakuṃbhīkukkuṭabhakṣaṇe surāsīdhumadhumadyapāne ayājyayājane patitasāvitryupanayane taiḥ prāyaścittaṃ brāhmaṇebhyo nivedya yatra grāmamṛgāṇāṃ paśūnāṃ śabdo na śrūyate tasminpradeśe agniṃ praṇiparisamuhya paryyuparissarya saśikhavapanaṃ kṛtvā prāk praṇītena vidhinā punaḥ saṃskāramarhantīti || atha pañcamahāpātakāḥ pravakṣyante brāhmaṇo naiva hantavyaḥ svasvaprakṣepayā dvijaiḥ suvarṇaharaṇaṃ caiva kartavyaṃ na kathaṃcana ||1|| surupatnīṃ na gaccheta saṃsparśaśca na taiścaret mahāpātakasaṃjñeyā nirdiṣṭānāṃ manīṣibhiḥ ||2|| vatsaratritayaṃ kuryāt naraḥ kṛcchraṃ viśuddhaye ātmatulyasuvarṇaṃ ca dadyādvāvipratuṣṭikṛt ||3|| ātreyīgarbhaṃ rājanyavaiśyau yajñagatau hatvā etadevakuryāt || athākālivyākhyāsyannāha aviniraṭakavidya tavajranirghātaprapatane bhūmicalane caivāthanimnottare caiva prāyaścittaṃ brāhmaṇebhyonivedya samīmayīnāṃ samidha madhudadhighṛtāktānāmaṣṭasāhasraṃ juhuyāt || śannodevīti kāśyapaḥ || yatra veśmani ulūkonipatati || gṛhaṃ godhākapotaḥ praviśati || kṛṣṭaḥ śakuniḥ śyeno vā rathabhujyevānipatati || valmīka dīpikāgṛhe puro dadati || śṛgāpurohaṇe kapāṭaghaṃṭāpurohaṇe caiva prāyaścittaṃ brāhmaṇebhyo nivedya śamīmayīnāṃ samidhadadhimadhughṛtāktānāmaṣṭasahasraṃ juhuyāt vāstospate iti kāśyapaḥ || atha naimittikāni vyākhyāsyāmaḥ kṣīrabhāṇḍabhedane maṃthane bhaṃjane purohalalāṃgala galacakratūpapatane rathaviparyyāsane aśvabhaṃjane rajasvalāśavasparśane ādityāstamane saṃdamaṃdeduḥsvapnadarśane karṇakeśapatipurohaṇe yūpasthalasparśana mṛtakasūtaka bhojane caiva brāhmaṇebhyo nivedya sacaile kṛtvā svapratirathaṃ japediti kāśyapaḥ || athātaḥ pātrāṇāṃ śaucavidhi vyākhyāsyāmaḥ palekhane na dārupatre bhasmanāṃkāṃsyaṃ śīśrutāstrāyasānāṃ sikatābhiḥ śaucaṃ || daṃtaśaṃkhamaṇirājatasauvarṇānāṃ gharṣaṇaṃ || mṛṇmayānāṃ punardahanaṃ || dhānyavāsasāṃ vahūnāṃ prokṣaṇaṃ kāṣṭha rajjutvakcarma cīra veṇu vidalapatraparṇānāṃ calavacchaucam || atha pūrva pāpakarmaṇāṃ cihnaṃ vyākhyāsyāmaḥ agamyāgāmī duścarmā tasmātprāyaścittaṃ vedātmaviśuddhaye || etān śrāddheparivarjayet ye cānye paṃktidūṣakāḥ || kṣaṭṭaghaṭā cā ghaṭānaṭā pravrajitaraṃgāratānidevalakanakṣatrajīvakagrāmayājakaparyyāhitaparyyādhārakaviviṃdakapaunarbhavānāśnaṃti || adantādeke nāśnaṃti || bhāryājitasya nagaragrāmayājakebhyaḥ aviśrastaghātī vyaṃgonakṣatra sūcakāḥ || varjanīyādvijāhyete śrāddhakarmasu nityaśaḥ dārādhīnāḥ kriyāḥ sarvā dārāḥ svargasya sādhanaṃ ||4|| ityetatbrahmaṇāproktaṃ kāśyapasyānuśāsanam sapta paunarbhavā kanyā varjanīyā kulādhamāḥ ||5|| vācā dattā manodattā kṛtamaṃgalakautukā udakasparśakā yā ca yā ca pāṇigrahītikā ||6|| agnyupāyaṃ gatā yā ca punarvāhyasya vādikā ityetāḥ kaśyapaproktā daheyuḥ kulamagnivat ||7|| prarohatyagnimādāya pādapānāṃ kulaṃmahat na hi punarbhavādīnāṃ kulaṃ tasya prarohati ||8|| pitā vā yadi vā bhrātā mātā vā yadivetaraḥ naraśca kṛtapāpānāṃ gati yāṃ yāti tāṃ śṛṇu ||9|| manivartī yathā śyeno gacchatyeva yamālayaṃ evaṃ ca narakaṃ yāti kanyā amṛtakārakā ||10|| punaḥ sampadyate nārī gatamātmānamātmani asthimātraṃ tvacaṃ bhitvā śukraṃ tejobalaṃ tathā ||11|| śuddhiṃ na ye prayacchaṃti duhitaraṃ lobhamohitāḥ teṣāṃ tu narake ghore yāti vai saptamaṃ kulam ||12|| gamanāgamanāyogāt evaṃ śukre vidhīyate evaṃ jñātvā yuktakanyāṃ viṃdeta sa tatkulāt ||13|| nasyāddaive ca pitrye ca dāsīsyādatha saṃcitā krayakrītā tu sā dāsī na sā patnī vidhīyate ||14|| agniṣṭomātirātrāṇāṃ śataṃ śataguṇī kṛtam prāpnoti puruṣodatvā homamaṃtrai ralaṃkṛtām ||15|| yastu sātyamadharmeṇa pitā samarpayet sutām sa pretya labhate sthānaṃ yathā dakṣa prajāpatiḥ ||16|| iti kāśyapa praṇītaṃ dharmaśāstraṃ samāptam
